collision_review.coordination: The primary registry accepts definitions and requires implementation and usage guidance elsewhere. Neither reviewed NIP-01 nor the registry contribution guidance requires central assignment permission. These are Radroots protocol assignments, not a claim of registry inclusion or exclusive global reservation.
collision_review.proposal_search: Exact numeric searches across issues and pull requests in both primary repositories returned zero results with incomplete_results=false on the review date.
collision_review.limits: A pinned source census and proposal search cannot prove global nonuse. No external maintainers were contacted. One owner reviewed the assignments; independent producer interoperability and full protocol acceptance remain pending.

rules: Commerce content is closed radroots.commerce v1 and is carried only by unsigned kind8890 rumors, NIP-44 v2 encrypted under signed kind13 seals and durable kind1059 gift wraps.
Kind14 remains NIP-17 plaintext chat; it is not a structured-commerce fallback. Kinds78 and30078 are not cross-application commerce substitutes.

Seal tags are empty. Authenticate the outer signature and recipient, then the seal signature, then recompute the rumor ID. Seal author, rumor author, content author and participant/recipient bindings must agree before admission.
Peer and self copies retain identical logical content and record identity with distinct recipient-specific seals and envelopes. Preserve each obtained result independently.

Capability kind18890 is replaceable per author and kind, has closed radroots.capabilities v1 content, and carries no d coordinate, grant, stock balance or trusted endpoint. Support is a bounded participant claim, not authority.

Authenticate observed heads before supported-profile, expiry or clock-actionability filtering. Newer authentic unsupported or anomalous heads prevent actionable fallback; bad signatures do not replace heads.
Recipient routing uses kind10050 DM relay information. Structured support readiness is distinct from route reachability; no advertised usable route blocks sending.
Existing kind30402 listings and their d coordinates, service event reservations, NIP-01 tag order, public interoperability and separately typed record/rumor/seal/envelope identities remain distinct.
Unknown profile versions and types remain unsupported evidence rather than partially interpreted records. Exact tags and bounded parsers require prospective qualification before authoring.
